source.translation_status: structured English summary based on the Russian original

recommended_professions: Startup Manager / Head of New Projects

strong_recommendation.summary: Managing people and work processes, making key decisions, and handling strategic planning.
Negotiation, presentations, promotion, and external-facing organizational processes.
Developing new products, services, and technologies; creative and inventive work.
Information analysis, forecasting, identifying mechanisms and root causes, and working through solutions.

partial_recommendation.summary: Project management, new business directions, and entrepreneurship.
Professional competence, practical implementation of technologies, and deep specialization.
Control and audit of other people's work, ensuring qualitative and quantitative performance indicators.
Planning and administering work processes, maintaining order and operational stability.

not_recommended_as_primary.summary: Client service, support, account management, and service-oriented roles.
Purely execution-oriented, regulated, internal organizational work.

introversion_extraversion.summary: Balanced orientation toward both the external and internal world; combines action with reflection.

feeling_thinking.summary: Strong analytical orientation, objectivity, reliance on independent judgment, and consistent reasoning.

sensing_intuition.summary: Combines intuition with practicality, paying attention both to new possibilities and to current execution.

improvisation_planning.summary: Flexible, adaptive, open to new options, and oriented toward process and optionality rather than rigid planning.

yielding_influence.summary: Tends to influence, defend interests, and push decisions toward implementation; useful for leadership roles.

core_pattern: management and analytics are the main vector
communications and innovation are strong supporting axes
technology and project work fit best as part of broader roles rather than as the sole identity
pure service and purely execution-oriented roles are a weaker fit
repo_alignment: aligns with the current positioning as systems architect / digital transformation lead / people-facing systems leader
supports movement toward roles with management, analysis, implementation, and stakeholder-facing responsibility
